name: smwgraphics-mario-and-wario-blargg
title: Mario and Wario - Blargg
description:
A background I ripped from the Japan-only SNES release "Mario & Wario". It's just one of the only BG's in the game that only uses one ExGFX file ^_^

Palette, Map16, and sample level included. Credit isn't necessary, but it would be nice.
